name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-1
title_zh: 把主题变成一张留白极简的日韩风杂志海报
tagline_zh: 给一句话、一张照片或一个念头，就生成诗意海报提示词和配图。大留白、旧纸纹理、实验字体，像独立杂志内页。
tagline_en: Turn a phrase, photo, or mood into a poetic zine poster prompt plus matching image—quiet, aged-paper, editorial.
desc_en: Generate Minimal Zine Poster v0.1 poetic paper-poster prompts and the matching generated image. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, or content brief and wants a quiet Japanese/Korean zine-like editorial poster with large negative space, aged paper texture, experimental typography, restrained color accents, and a generated bitmap image.
why_zh: 它不堆模板，而是把输入拆成版式、纸张、字型、色调四层，再重组为可执行的提示词，让每张海报都有手作感。
why_en: It decomposes input into layout, paper, type, and palette, then reweaves them into a concrete prompt—so every poster feels.
limit_zh: 只输出提示词和一张生成图，不负责排版或印刷。需要你本地有图像生成API密钥；若输入是复杂长文，它会简化成单一意象。
limit_en: Outputs only a prompt and one image; no layout or print. Requires your own image-gen API key. Long inputs get condensed to one core image, losing.
